name: bitvault-psbt
description:
**BitVault**'s treasury moves funds through a 2-of-2 co-signer. Every payout
is screened against the operation the desk approved and only then relayed to
the network. Last cycle a routine payroll payout was co-signed -- and what
settled on-chain instead swept the whole treasury to an address nobody
recognizes.

You have the full co-signer stack and the forensic trail:

    ENVELOPE_FORMAT.md    the BVLT-COSIGN/2 co-sign envelope format
    treasury_screen.py    the policy screen (authorizer)
    settlement_relay.py   the settlement relay (broadcaster)
    cosigner.py           the pipeline + the sealed post-mortem note
    signed_draft.txt      the co-signed benign payroll draft
    incident_brief.md     the drain output recovered from the node

No server is running. The desk's post-mortem note is sealed under the
settlement the co-signer *actually relayed*; reconstruct that settlement from
the shipped files alone and recover the note.

Stuck? Hints are available (they cost a few points).

Flag format: NCTF{...}
